WELCOME TO YOUR LITTLE OFFICE

This is an interactive workspace with a Malaysian neighbourhood, enterable Crow HQ, and animated employee routines. Create and assign tasks, track their stages, review proposals, and keep your own notes.
What is live?
The characters move in an animated office. Team chat uses live AI replies in the protected workspace, with conversation history stored privately. The map, notes, and existing local tasks are saved on this browser. Run a saved task to receive an AI draft for review.
Your daily team report
Your existing 10 PM team report in ChatGPT is separate. It is not connected to this office yet. You can add its ideas to the work board yourself.
Private chat history and chat task submissions sync through the protected room. Clearing browser data clears local notes and map preferences. The existing scheduled daily report remains separate.
